LESSON: GUIDED WRITING

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Writing
Topic 3.7: Guided Writing
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 1

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Guided Writing, part of Writing in Grade 4 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: how they can maintain body hygiene and grooming with peers. How can you cultivate an interest in writing Chinese characters?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. label a chart showing parts of the body (头、肩 膀、膝盖、脚、眼睛、耳朵、嘴巴、鼻子 ),

2. highlight parts of the body from a crossword puzzle,

3. listen to a song on parts of the body and fill in the missing words in the lyrics of the song,

4. trace the given simple characters using the correct stroke order (手、头),

5. use locally available materials to write Chinese characters on parts of the body collaboratively,

6. display the work for feedback from peers,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. label a chart showing parts of the body (头、肩 膀、膝盖、脚、眼睛、耳朵、嘴巴、鼻子 ),
2. highlight parts of the body from a crossword puzzle,
3. listen to a song on parts of the body and fill in the missing words in the lyrics of the song,
4. trace the given simple characters using the correct stroke order (手、头),
5. use locally available materials to write Chinese characters on parts of the body collaboratively,
6. display the work for feedback from peers,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Guided Writing together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication and Collaboration: The learner writes clearly and spells words correctly as they label the different parts of the

body from a chart.

Values:
Love: The learner develops a caring attitude for their bodies as they discuss with peers how they can maintain body hygiene and

grooming.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Self-awareness: the learner becomes aware of their body parts as they label parts of the body, as well as when they discuss how

to take care of themselves.

Link to other learning areas:

Learning is linked to English and Kiswahili on the importance of spelling words correctly for effective communication.
